title: Tom Clancy's The Division: Recruited
summary: Thomas Parrott's first Operation: Crossroads novel introduces Maira Kanhai's Division story in post-Green Poison Washington.

claims.text: Recruited is Thomas Parrott's first Operation: Crossroads novel in the licensed Tom Clancy's The Division publishing line, released by Aconyte Books in 2022.
The official premise places Maira Kanhai in the aftermath of Green Poison in Washington, where a Division agent's death opens a path to recruitment while a threat targets the agency.
Aconyte's author interview describes Recruited as taking place after The Division 2, during a period when order is beginning to return to Washington without restoring normal life.

paragraphs.text: Recruited opens Thomas Parrott's licensed Operation: Crossroads sequence. It is an official Division transmedia novel, not a game mission or a replacement for game-source chronology.

The public setup follows Maira Kanhai from Washington's post-Green Poison civilian crisis toward SHD recruitment. Aconyte places that starting point after The Division 2, while the archive keeps the novel's later plot developments source-specific.

verification.notes: Official publisher metadata establishes the work, series position and public premise. Archive records use original, source-specific summaries and reproduce no novel prose, cover art or scans.
